svg.text: Conformal diagrams of the exact family: the future of the ingoing null cone v = v₀ (v₀ = −7)
Null coordinates: the second is v; the first labels the outgoing rays by where they cross v = v₀ (log scale about the reference ray: the event horizon for β < 0, the static horizon for β > 0).
Left: collapse, β < 0 (curves of finite ρ are drawn to v* − 2·10⁻³; they reach P* only in the limit). Right: expansion, β > 0. β = ±1; any other |β| is a v-translation.
β = −1, v* = 0: the cone v = v* ends the diagram at the top right
β = +1: no event horizon; no trapped region
β = −1, v* = 0: the cone v = v* ends the diagram at the top right
β = +1: no event horizon; the trapped lens closes at v = -3.16
